channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
item.description: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.

item.title: Under Trump, NIH funding disruptions have evolved. Here's what the numbers show
item.description: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.

item.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
item.description: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

item.title: Venezuela's acting leader promises elections at the 'right moment'
item.description: Venezuela's acting president, delivering her first address to the U.N. General Assembly since coming to power, promised elections and said the nation's people will determine the "right moment."

item.title: Senators press President Trump to release home heating oil reserves amid soaring prices
item.description: Maine's U.S. Sens. Susan Collins and Angus King, Jr., called upon President Donald Trump to release home heating oil reserves to drive prices down.

item.title: Major pro-life group threatens to sue Trump FDA over abortion pill's alleged environmental risks
item.description: Students for Life of America threatens to sue the Food and Drug Administration, alleging it skipped Endangered Species Act reviews for mifepristone.

item.title: Dem Senate hopeful dished out thousands to radical staffer who glorified Hamas: 'Freedom fighters'
item.description: Sara Mahmoud's posts wishing Zionists would "die" surfaced after she was hired to manage social media for DSA-backed Senate candidate Angie Nixon.

item.title: Trump-Xi reunion comes with unfinished business — and a bigger battle looming
item.description: President Donald Trump hosts Xi Jinping to test whether China delivered on rare earths, AI and trade promises from their May breakthrough deal.

item.title: Daughter of Chinese Uyghur prisoner makes emotional plea to Trump during spotlight Xi summit
item.description: Ziba Murat hopes Trump will raise her mother Dr. Gulshar Abbas' case with Xi Jinping during the summit after eight years of imprisonment in China.

item.title: Melania Trump’s home-country leader rips UN ‘double standards’ as Trump promise is revealed
item.description: Janez Janša accused the United Nations of double standards on Gaza and Ukraine, and revealed Trump promised to visit Melania Trump's homeland.

item.title: Florida couple recounts 'miraculous' rescue after surviving harrowing lightning strike during evening stroll
item.description: Police bodycam video captured the frantic response after Aaron and Clare Walenga were struck on a popular trail in Winter Haven.

item.title: Lawsuits cost every American household thousands of dollars. Supreme Court can help
item.description: Supreme Court's October docket tackles climate lawsuits, digital privacy and retirement plan claims as U.S. tort costs approach $1 trillion by 2030.

item.title: Republicans face brutal midterm headwinds. Six forces could help them defy history.
item.description: With six weeks until Election Day, rising gas prices, Trump's 39% approval rating and redistricting wars will shape the 2026 midterm battle.

item.title: Federal judge orders Trump administration to restore White House access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: A federal judge ordered that President Donald Trump must restore White House press credentials for CNN, MS NOW and Politico, finding the outlets likely to prevail in court.

item.title: Tennessee cops raided man's home after he criticized officer for speeding: lawsuit
item.description: A First Amendment lawsuit alleges Kingsport Police in Tennessee raided Joshua Gibbons' home after he filmed and criticized a cop speeding at night.

item.title: Illegal alien allegedly grabs school police officer's gun, shoots him in femoral artery: DOJ
item.description: Jose Santiago Pantoja-Morales allegedly grabbed a Dallas ISD officer's gun during a struggle and shot him in the femoral artery near LBJ Freeway.

item.title: Michigan student confronts El-Sayed over Iran stance in tense exchange: ‘Do you stand with us?’
item.description: A Persian student confronted Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed over leaked audio about Iran's Khamenei and his silence on the IRGC.

item.title: Tropical Storm Nolo tracker: Map and projected storm path
item.description: Nolo is the 14th named storm of the hurricane season in the central Pacific.

item.title: Officials seek answers after man police say was fleeing ICE dies in car crash
item.description: The man was driving Sunday morning in Grand Rapids, Michigan, when at some point before the crash ICE attempted to stop the vehicle, police said.
